env: A host with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC credentials, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This generation-focused eval composes a warehouse 2D (RT-DETR) deployment from the `warehouse` industry Foundation at `deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/`, which is NOT a developer profile: its env layers are `containers.env` + the warehouse `.env` + the warehouse `overrides.env` + the build's `override.env`, and its `compose.yml` must include the shared TURN overlay `services/infra/compose-no-turn-tcp-relay.yml` alongside the root compose file. The Foundation sets no `COMPOSE_PROFILES` directly; it defines `COMPOSE_PROFILES_WH_*` lists and the build selects one by variant. Evaluator context: the expected baseline is `COMPOSE_PROFILES_WH_2D` expanded unchanged. This is the `BP_PROFILE=bp_wh` variant — the ONLY warehouse variant that ships an agent tier (agent, UI, VA-MCP, Phoenix, alert-bridge and the always-local RTVI VLM), so unlike every other warehouse eval those services MUST be present. `bp_wh` is 2D-only, has no `_MINIMAL` counterpart, and is rejected by the configurator on `IGX-THOR` and `DGX-SPARK`. The query asks for a remote LLM, which matters on a 2-GPU target: RT-CV takes device 0 and the RTVI VLM device 1, leaving none for a local NIM. `LLM_MODE=remote` with `LLM_NAME_SLUG=none` makes the trailing `llm_${LLM_MODE}_${LLM_NAME_SLUG}` token of `COMPOSE_PROFILES_WH_2D` resolve to `llm_remote_none`, which matches no NIM compose profile, so no local LLM container is activated; the key must stay in dynamic form and never be pre-expanded. For remote, `LLM_BASE_URL` is the endpoint root WITHOUT a trailing `/v1` — the agent config appends it. `scripts/validate_warehouse_env.py` only demands a `services/nim/<slug>/hw-<HARDWARE_PROFILE>.env` sizing file when `LLM_MODE=local`, so remote must not reference one. Warehouse always uses the integrated RTVI VLM, so `VLM_MODE` and `VLM_NAME_SLUG` stay `none` even though a VLM is running. `nv-warehouse-4cams` is the only dataset valid for this variant and pairs with `NUM_STREAMS=4`; a mismatch surfaces as a short stream count with every container healthy. `bp-configurator-2d` loads its env through `env_file:` rather than Compose interpolation, so the build must render a `configurator.env` and point `BP_CONFIGURATOR_ENV_FILE` at it, or the `<HOST_IP>` sentinel is baked into the container that renders every stream config. The build label `wh-2` is directory metadata only and must never become a Compose profile.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to build under `_builds/wh-2/`: "Deploy warehouse 2D multi-camera perception across 4 cameras with behavior analytics and Kafka metadata, plus the chat agent and web UI so an operator can ask questions about the floor. Use a remote LLM endpoint." Target `{{platform}}`, validate the resolved Compose configuration, do not deploy, and do not create, modify, or delete anything under `deploy/docker/`.
checks: The effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` is the expanded literal list, not a `${COMPOSE_PROFILES_WH_2D}` reference, and contains `perception-2d`, `vss-behavior-analytics-2d`, `bp-configurator-2d`, `nvstreamer-2d`, `sensor-ms-2d`, `streamprocessing-ms-2d`, `kafka` and `elasticsearch`.
The agent tier IS present, which is unique to this variant: `vss-agent`, `vss-ui`, `vss-va-mcp`, `phoenix`, `alert-bridge` and `rtvi-vlm` all appear in `COMPOSE_PROFILES`.

The LLM NIM key is carried in its dynamic form `llm_${LLM_MODE}_${LLM_NAME_SLUG}` and is NOT pre-expanded to a literal such as `llm_local_nvidia-nemotron-nano-9b-v2`. `override.env` sets `LLM_MODE=remote` and `LLM_NAME_SLUG=none`, so the token resolves to `llm_remote_none`, and `LLM_BASE_URL` is an endpoint root with no trailing `/v1`.

No local LLM NIM is activated: `resolved.yml` resolves no service from `deploy/docker/services/nim/`, and `override.env` references no `hw-<HARDWARE_PROFILE>.env` sizing file — on a 2-GPU target RT-CV holds device 0 and the RTVI VLM device 1, leaving none for a local NIM.

`override.env` sets `MODE=2d`, `BP_PROFILE=bp_wh`, `STREAM_TYPE=kafka`, `SAMPLE_VIDEO_DATASET=nv-warehouse-4cams` and `NUM_STREAMS=4`, and keeps both `VLM_MODE=none` and `VLM_NAME_SLUG=none` despite the RTVI VLM running.
No 3D service leaks in: `perception-3d`, `ds-configurator-3d`, `vss-behavior-analytics-3d`, `nvstreamer-3d` are all absent, and `FOUNDATION_VARIANT` is `COMPOSE_PROFILES_WH_2D`.

The warehouse infrastructure floor is intact: `init-dirs`, `render-config`, `wdm-env-from-config`, `wait-for-redis`, `wait-for-docker-workloads`, `sdr-controller`, `centralizedb`, `vst-ingress`, `sensor-bp-wait-bp-configurator`, `turnserver-init`, `turnserver` and `redis` are all present, including `redis` despite `STREAM_TYPE=kafka`.
`_builds/wh-2/compose.yml` includes both `../../deploy/docker/compose.yml` and `../../deploy/docker/services/infra/compose-no-turn-tcp-relay.yml` in one ordered `path` list.

`override.env` materializes the full transitive dependent-value closure: `SDR_CONTROLLER_CONFIG_PATH` and `NVSTREAMER_2D_CONFIG_DIR` both resolve through `warehouse-2d-app`, and `TURN_PUBLIC_HOST` carries a concrete host value rather than inheriting the `<HOST_IP>` sentinel through `EXTERNAL_IP` and `VSS_PUBLIC_HOST`.
`_builds/wh-2/configurator.env` exists, contains no `<HOST_IP>` or `/path/to/` sentinel, no oversized runaway-expansion value, and `override.env` sets `BP_CONFIGURATOR_ENV_FILE` to that path.
`resolved.yml` was generated with the four ordered env layers rooted at `deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/`, not at any `developer-profiles/dev-profile-*` directory.

After normalization, `resolved.yml` carries no `profiles:` gates and resolves a non-empty service list including `vios-apt-cache-init`, which is ungated and expected even though it appears in no `COMPOSE_PROFILES_WH_*` list.
`scripts/validate_resolved_yml.py` and `scripts/validate_warehouse_env.py` both exit 0 against the build.
Nothing under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` was created, modified, or deleted; in particular no in-tree `generated.env` was written.
